list.snippet: Coronary artery disease: Narrowing or blockage of the arteries that supply blood to the heart
Heart attack: When a coronary artery becomes completely blocked, causing damage to the heart muscle
Stroke: When blood flow to the brain is interrupted, causing damage to brain cells
Heart failure: When the heart cannot pump blood effectively
High blood pressure: Excessive force of blood against the artery walls

text_blocks.snippet: CVD is the leading cause of death globally, accounting for over 17 million deaths annually. It can affect people of all ages, but the risk increases with age and other factors such as smoking, obesity, high cholesterol, and high blood pressure.
